typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max `text-6xl` or `text-7xl`. Never use center-everything approach. Rely on left-alignment and sharp optical balance.

colors.instruction: Use arbitrary Tailwind classes (e.g., `bg-[#F5F4F0]`, `text-[#1C1A17]`) to enforce this palette on the page and avoid clashing with the existing site's electric blue/black style.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use sharp 1px borders (`border-[#1C1A17]/15`) to create an editorial/ledger look. No heavy tactile shadows.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Sharp corners (`rounded-none`) or extremely subtle radii (`rounded-sm`) to reflect a serious, magazine-like Brutalist aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must shift colors or subtly translate. CTAs in Terracotta should darken on hover `hover:bg-[#A03A24]`.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for simple staggered fade-in-up entrances on scroll (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}`).

layouts.hero: Asymmetric split. Left: massive H1 text and CTAs in a Deep Forest Green container (`bg-[#1B2A22] text-[#F5F4F0]`). Right: Full height image.
layouts.problem_section: Editorial text block. Large drop-cap or oversized quotation style. Sticky H2 on the left, flowing narrative on the right.
layouts.how_it_works: Bento grid (Mode A). Use oversized numerals (`01`, `02`, `03`) in `font-display` or `font-mono-label` with accent color. Avoid 3 boring equal columns.
layouts.multi_trade: Long-form editorial section. Two columns. Incorporate the team image with an offset overlapping caption.
layouts.comparison_table: Ledger style. Do not use an HTML table. Use a CSS grid where each row has a sharp top and bottom border. HCOB column should be visually prioritized.
layouts.case_study: Inverted dark section (`bg-[#1B2A22] text-[#F5F4F0]`). Brutalist metrics, large display numbers.
layouts.services_grid: 14 items. Use an editorial grid (`grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5`) with visible 1px borders separating every item (Technical Look).
layouts.quote_section: Embed `<QuoteRequestForm />` within a warm, grounded container. Generous padding (`p-12`).

case_study_image.description: Compressed bales of mixed paper (Recycling Operation)

seo_and_metadata.document_title: HCOB Network | Managed Home & Property Services in Baltimore
seo_and_metadata.meta_description: One call, every trade. HCOB Network manages your entire project — cleaning, junk removal, painting, roofing & more — with vetted local pros in Maryland.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT reuse the old electric blue/black aesthetic. Implement the custom color variables described in this JSON via arbitrary Tailwind classes (`bg-[#F5F4F0]`, `text-[#1C1A17]`, `bg-[#1B2A22]`, `bg-[#C84B31]`).
Use Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react`) or `lucide-react`. DO NOT use emojis.
Do not touch the routing. Keep `<QuoteRequestForm />` exactly as an embedded component without redesigning its internals.
Implement the SEO `useEffect` to set document.title and meta description on mount.
Ensure the header is sticky with a glassmorphism effect (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F5F4F0]/80`) and contains the primary CTA button and mobile phone icon.
Do not use generic Inter font for headings. Apply `font-display` to all H1, H2, H3 elements.
Avoid symmetric centered text blocks. Use sharp left-aligned typography.
The 14 services MUST be included in the Services section.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (centered layouts, simplistic gradients, uniform styling).
Create depth through layered design elements and distinctive layouts.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Never use placeholder URLs (like placehold.co or via.placeholder.com). Use ONLY the provided `image_urls`.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive and structural elements.
